_doc: Plan 131: the BDO day / night cycle. period_min = real minutes per game day, night_min = real minutes of it that are night, night_from / night_to = game-clock HH:MM where night starts / ends (the game clock runs faster at night). titles = hints that mark a minimap game-time tooltip shot (case / punctuation-insensitive). Seed values are unverified community figures; one operator screenshot of the minimap game-time tooltip calibrates the clock and a second confirms it.
source: community figures (4 h real day, 40 min night, night 22:00-07:00 game time); deep dive 0026 (Global Lab notes 2026-10-08: drop chance rises at night)
